description: This Java class defines a ProductEntity that extends the Product class and implements Serializable. It encapsulates various product properties such as price, quantity, SKU, dimensions, weight, ratings, availability, and other attributes relevant to e-commerce products.

classes.name: ProductEntity
classes.description: A Java class representing a product entity with attributes like price, quantity, SKU, dimensions, weight, rating, availability, and serialization support.
